criteria.requirement: Changes protect user work and avoid destructive git or filesystem operations.
criteria.verification: Confirm worktree state, review diff, and avoid unrelated overwrites.

criteria.requirement: Secrets, SSH keys, credentials, lockout-sensitive SSH flows, mode isolation, lockout safety, rollback evidence, and fail-fast expectations are governed.
criteria.verification: Run npm run check:ssh-hardening-contract and secret scans before commit.

criteria.requirement: Governance surfaces remain mapped, maintainable, and source-of-truth oriented.
Documentation links Master Prompt, objective coverage, operational tracking, generated reports, and change checklist.
criteria.verification: Run report checks and confirm generated reports are current.

criteria.requirement: Dedicated checks are wired into governance quality scripts.
criteria.verification: Run npm run check:seis-master-prompt-report and npm run check:seis-master-prompt.

criteria.requirement: AI, cloud, product, design, and mobile SSH readiness stay tracked without overstated readiness claims.
criteria.verification: Run objective coverage and operational goal tracker checks before claiming readiness.

criteria.requirement: The active God Mode objective is incomplete unless Dashboard, Goals, Repos, Docs, Agents, security, AI policy, rollback, validation, and handoff all have explicit feature or governance improvement evidence.
criteria.verification: Run God Mode feature growth ledger, module coverage, work package, and completion audit checks before claiming the broad objective is complete.
